solver.build: official macOS release (x86_64, run under Rosetta on Apple Silicon), single process

geometry.description: NACA 0012 (NASA TMR definition, sharp trailing edge, unit chord)

field.encoding: int16 little-endian, base64, row-major from (x0, y0); value = int / scale; -32768 = no flow (inside a body)

limitations: Benchmark case for verifying the pipeline (NACA 0012, NASA TMR conditions); not car aerodynamics.
Compared with published RANS-SA results from other codes, which is verification, not experimental validation.
